notes.title: New release date for Boxing School DLC
notes.notes:
Today we announce a new release date for the Solo Career Mode DLC. In celebration of FIVE YEAR ANNIVERSARY for Boxing School the new release date will be moved to 10th January 2024.

[b]Message from the dev team[/b]
[i]"This expansion DLC turned out to be better then we expected. Boxing school as a single boxer standalone campaign have great potential. We realize that we have a good opportunity here to release something very special in the "Boxing career RPG story theme". We have decided to delay the release a month and give it our best to add alot more content, extra polish and playtesting before we release. Thanks for your patience and support."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/ff3042d85372ebeefa587ce9bfab6a8f0864f62b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/b9424a1ed2a291dc8456f57348414d8a07e2bbe5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/8afa3ff7b53f2efe613fe3246ce28e04853a43df.jpg[/img]

[h2]Boxing School : Solo Career Mode DLC [/h2]
[b]New Release date:[/b] 10th January 2024 on Steam

Step into the shoes of a rookie boxer trying to survive. You'll be juggling your training, work, recreational time, and possible stardom. Play your own career story from beginner to star. With great struggle comes great rewards.

[b]Be a part of the rivalry[/b]
This expansion offers new gameplay with more detailed and in-depth rivalry system. All top contenders now have unique personality types that always seek to win out over their greatest threats, sparking drama and rivalry in the top around the champion belt.

[b]Choose your manager[/b]
Now you are the boxer and you will choose your own manager along the way. All managers have different sets of skills, talents and ambitions. Remember that a manager will have great impact on your career. Choose wisely.

[b]Upgrade your own house[/b]
How will you spend your earnings outside the ring? Can you afford to upgrade your house or your gym equipment? Maybe take a vacation to relax between fights? Or maybe you can buy that new sports car that you always have been dreaming about if you win the next big fight.

[h3]Key Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Create your own boxer and play a new expanded career story mode.
[*]Hire a manager or a promoter to arrange fights and sign deals.
[*]Buy, upgrade and manage your own house and gym equipment.
[*]Choose your strategy in fights, adjust your tactics between rounds.
[*]Become famous and gain worldwide fans or even fanclubs.
[*]Earn the right to challenge the champion himself for the title belt.
[*]New story generator for Solo RPG boxing career
[*]New competition ranking system
[*]New world events and rivalry system
[*]New fresh music tracks composed for this DLC
[/list]
[h1]Wishlist today![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543230/Boxing_School__Solo_Career_Mode/

notes.title: Expansion release date is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/abbc8030a57ddfc3e43d211a4ac8ab90da93548a.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We have great news today. The release date for the expansion is finally here. It will be out in 3 months here on Steam. Many fresh new exciting things added to the game and also other improvements, interface refinements, tweaks, optimizations and bug fixes.

[h3]EXPANSION DLC RELEASE DATE[/h3]
[b]Boxing School: Ready to Rumble[/b] will be available on [b]30th March 2023[/b] and it will be [b]free content[/b] as announced earlier together with the version 1.16 update to the basegame. 

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
We have talked before about what to expect, but here’s a quick recap:
[h3]TOURNAMENTS [/h3]
[i](Playoff brackets - elimination rounds)[/i]
*New Boxing Competition Authority - "FightCorp"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/fc67b8d08da7c61fc0b1e7bfabd4cd0f1a8bdb1b.png[/img]
If you lose a fight then you are out of the tournament

[h3]BOXING PROMOTERS [/h3]
[i](Staff leveling, Staff reputation)[/i]
Hire and manage your own boxing promoters inhouse
Assign and select them to promote any fight

[h3]PRESS CONFERENCE[/h3]
[i](Media events and drama)[/i]
New event before big fights.
Generates stories.

[h3]NEW GYM EQUIPMENT[/h3]
[b]POWERHOUSE GEAR[/b]
[i](Faster leveling for boxers)[/i]
New gymshop advanced upgrades

[b]PUNCHMASTER DELUXE MACHINE[/b]
[i](Test your boxers)[/i]
The latest 80s technology to measure punching power

[h3]VIP SPONSORDEALS and 80s MOVIE CONTRACTS[/h3]
[i](Advanced sponsor negotiations)[/i]
Deals of a lifetime with big brands

[h3]MANAGER OFFICE[/h3]
[i](Manager options)[/i]
Your own area in the gym

[h3]ARRANGE SEVERAL BIG FIGHTS AT ONCE[/h3]
We have been following feedback across the community and players want to be able to arrange several major big fights at once. This has now been added in this update!

[h3]SODA MACHINE[/h3]
[i](Inhouse buff to boxer stamina)[/i]
The latest Beastmaster model. Can you afford it?

[h3]QUALITY OF LIFE - QoL Patch v1.16[/h3]
This is a MAJOR update that adds tons of improvements, fixes and UI refinements to the basegame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/191d97351e615a2f3881775dfb4c65536a3aa995.png[/img]

[h3][i]Boxing School: Ready to Rumble is the next full DLC expansion for the ultimate boxing tycoon management game on Steam. This expansion adds new features such as tournaments, press conference, boxing promoters, manager office, gym upgrades, 80s movie contracts, VIP sponsordeals, staff leveling, staff reputation, gymshop equipment, soda machine and much more...[/i][/h3]

[h3]Message from the team[/h3]
We(the boxing school team) have been working on this expansion for the past year. The game deserves this update and we have taken our time to make sure the new features are a good fit for the gameplay. Press conference events and the story generator to create media drama in the boxing world has taken the longest time to implement. It has also been challenging to get the balancing right for the tournaments aswell but we love this game and we have alot of passion for the project. We want this game to be the best it can be. And we will work hard to make that happen. As always, if you have feedback regarding anything or you have a suggestion, make sure to let us know on the Steam forum. Thanks for your support.

[h3]One last thing...[/h3]
A secondary team in our studio here in Sweden are currently working on a new game that will be released in 2 months here on Steam. If you like Boxing School there is a big chance you might enjoy this game aswell. Tower Walker has the same Directors/Project leaders as Boxing School. It is a new concept fresh from the same minds that came up with Boxing School and Dino Nest.

If that sounds interesting maybe you would like to check it out...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2130060/Tower_Walker_MMO_Grind_Simulator/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/a6bcc9a74dc10f5ea7f5352835aea597bb54f566.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE v1.14 coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/90d1a75156fbe19af859bb6590341c7d60df5b24.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We have been working on the next major update for Boxing School for some time now. Here is what you can expect in version 1.14. Specific launch date will be announced soon. We always appreciate and try our best to apply any feedback given by you to make the game the best experience it can possibly be, so dont forget to leave any feedback you may have in the forums. It matters to us. We love this game, that is why we work very hard and take our time to test all new content before releasing anything. It will be ready soon. Thanks for your support!
 
[h3]What will be added in the next update...[/h3]
[list]
[*] Negotiation options when arranging big fight events
[*] Improvements to feedback regarding injuries and special treatments
[*] More interaction options with other trainers, boxers and promoters 
(more stuff to do in the competition menus)
[*] Difficulty and customization options when starting a new game
(starting conditions, scenario editor, boxer editor)
[*] More options in contract renewal negotiations
[*] More gym decorations and building options
[*] More content to events and news
[*] Visible feedback for boxer career milestones 
[*] Balance improvements and interface refinements
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33633853/2c323629c4bc33c8334d0e512ff7137cfc0d1ab4.jpg[/img]
[h3]This is what we are thinking about maybe adding in the future...[/h3]
- NPC story lategame questline with reputation rewards
- Career Mode - where you play as a solo boxer

[h3]Dont forget to check out Dino Nest...[/h3]
If you want to support the other part of our studio then check out the new survival game that will be coming out next week. Wishlist and follow!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373930/
Have a good weekend!
